what: Offline S11 extraction from the openEMS referee's stored port records.

method.dft: sum_k x_k exp(-2j*pi*f*t_k) * median(dt)  -- rectangular window, full record
method.note_phase: phase not comparable to the artefact without de-embedding to x=20.4 mm

capture.snapshot_note: 820 rows / 8.201738196e-09 s describe the record snapshot actually read (port files 30060 B, mtime 2026-11-09 ~18:00 UTC). The record files in evidence/referee/ were subsequently rewritten by a later host-side write whose headers are stamped 'Mon Nov  9 19:21:08 2026' local; they settled at 813 rows / 8.131638e-09 s / 47.39 periods. The port_1 values below reproduce to 8-9 significant digits from that later snapshot (U=-1.1225952338e-13-3.0942255092e-14j, I=9.1523936999e-17-3.3049120887e-16j, S11=0.9578897496-0.2883480888j, |S11|=1.0003486356, arg=-16.753071 deg); the difference is a partial run's worth of tail samples and does not affect the |S11|~1 finding.

provenance_check.claim_checked: that the 820-row / 8.2017 ns port record is consistent with the stated 10647-timestep run (it is; an earlier reading said it was not)
provenance_check.resolution: the port write interval is NOT the solver step: the records are written every 13th timestep
provenance_check.et_ht_grid_check: all 639 et timestamps are integer multiples of solver_dt_s to within 3.8e-16 s, which is the 6-significant-figure print rounding of the ASCII t column; ht sits on half-integer multiples (the Yee stagger)
provenance_check.cfl_check_note: 0.4 mm uniform cell, dx/(c*sqrt(3)) with c = 299792458 m/s reproduces solver_dt_s
provenance_check.et_ht_no_metadata: et and ht carry zero '%' header lines -- no openEMS version, no timestamp, no window declaration -- so from the files alone it cannot be determined whether their 0.4915 ns window (5.99 % of the run) was configured or truncated. Not needed for the S11 number: the extraction reads only port_ut_1 and port_it_1.
provenance_check.effect_on_s11: none: decimation changes data density, not per-sample values, and 5.8278 GHz is 11.7 % of the record's 49.93 GHz Nyquist. This is NOT a fix for |S11| ~ 1.
provenance_check.rerun_note: SetPortDataCounter(1) would store 10647 samples over 106.6 ns (621 periods at F_REF) instead of 820 over 8.20 ns (47.8 periods) -- a data-density improvement that removes the bin-alignment caveat, not a fix for the physics.

port_2.note: port 2 is the 50 ohm series load (excite=0); (U/50-I)/(U/50+I) is NOT a reflection coefficient there. Its U/I is reported as a load check.

adequacy.length: ADEQUATE for a single bin: 47.8 periods at 5.8278 GHz, tail decayed to ~1.2e-8 of peak, full-record and first-half results agree to 6e-7.
adequacy.bin_alignment: NOT bin-aligned: the capture spans 47.8 periods, so F_REF is not an integer bin of this record; rectangular-window leakage is present.
adequacy.result_validity: NOT VALID as a referee S11. |S11| = 1.0003 at every frequency from 2 to 10 GHz, i.e. the port looks OPEN, not matched to ~0.33.
adequacy.localisation: The 50 ohm series load is present in the model: port 2 U/I = -49.8 + 3.0j ohm (|Z| = 49.9 ohm). The anomaly sits in port 1's U/I = -0.4 - 339.6j ohm, i.e. nearly purely reactive at the launch; |I|*50/|U| = 0.145 where ~0.5 is needed for |S11| = 0.33.
adequacy.hypothesis_unverified: Port-1 current is ~3.4x too small to yield a 0.33 reflection. Candidate causes (unverified here, no openEMS available): port-1 current normalisation/ground-return in the model, or port-data sampling/truncation. Needs a solver-side check.
adequacy.model_geometry_defect: DATED CORRECTION 2026-11-11 (referee-geometry-attach-2026-11-11): the two 2026-11-09 host runs solved EMPTY GEOMETRY -- openEMS warned 'Unused primitive (type: Box) detected in property: substrate!' and '... property: strip!  x2', and the lumped load reported 'Active cells: 0'. Solver-side numbers of that empty model: port-1 U/I = 317 ohm (a 50 ohm line was expected), the 50 ohm series load itself read 49.9 ohm, port1->port2 = -94 dB, |S11| = 1.0003 at every bin from 2 to 10 GHz; the FDTD core was healthy (converged on the -60 dB criterion, 10647 timesteps, ~73 s). So |S11| ~ 1 is a CORRECT measurement of a model with no substrate and no strip, not an extraction failure: the offline extraction over the same records gives port-1 U/I = -0.41 - 339.56j ohm, ~7% from 317 ohm, same conclusion. This defect supersedes the unverified hypothesis above as the explanation of the open-looking port; the model-side fix lives in build_A_referee.py (geometry_boxes(), check_boxes(), guard_solver_output() -> exit 4, no epsilon=1 air box, setup_only=True probe, exit 5 for missing bindings) and is AUTHORED-UNEXERCISED -- its acceptance criteria are not verified until a host run. Model/setup defect finding, not a residual and not an E12.
